[Updates] Patch Notes - October 8, 2026

Character Growth

  • The maximum character level has been raised from Lv. 70 to Lv. 75.
  • Combat EXP required per level and Combat EXP gained from monsters have been rescaled.
  • The EXP gained per monster kill is now capped by level (about 0.01% of the level at Lv. 62 or higher).

EXP Buffs

  • Body Enhancement: Combat EXP gain increased from 50% to 100%.
  • Adventure Blessing: Combat EXP gain increased from 15% to 30%.
  • Pearl Outfit set effect: Combat EXP gain increased from 10% to 50%.

Monster Zones

  • Monster zone info now lists the monsters and their EXP values.
  • The recommended level is now shown before each zone name.
